name: notion-project-docs
description: Create evidence-grounded project documentation and publish reviewed Git Markdown to dedicated Notion mirror pages by an explicit repository policy.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based docs with policy-driven Notion publishing.
interface.longDescription: Create portfolio-ready project overviews and technical case studies from repository evidence, validate publishable Markdown, and install a guarded GitHub Actions workflow with manual-by-default or explicit canonical-branch Notion publishing.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and create evidence-based project docs.
Validate the configured docs without publishing them.
